name: MetadataMapping
summary: The mapping between objects and tables held as data, rather than written as code.

roles.name: MetadataMapping
roles.summary: The mapping expressed as metadata a mapper reads — a file, attributes, a table — instead of hand-written per class. It removes a great deal of repetitive code and moves the cost: a mapping error is no longer a compilation failure, and what was explicit becomes something a reader must go and look up.
